sources.title: Idaho State Tax Commission: Withholding (web page)
sources.revision: web page, no edition printed; stored copy checked 2026-11-04
sources.verifiedBy: read from the stored copy in watcher/state/snapshots/id-882a4325e8.txt.gz: the descriptions of Form 910 (periodic return), Form 967 (annual reconciliation with W-2s), Form 96 (annual information return), electronic filing and substitute forms. The page does not state the filing frequencies or due dates of Form 910; those are on the Commission's 'Withholding filing' and 'Withholding paying' pages, which are not in the stored documents.

efile.text: Idaho requires you to file W-2s and Form 967 electronically if you're an employer who meets the IRS requirements to file W-2s electronically and you have 10 or more employees in Idaho.

notModelled: Form 967 (annual reconciliation with the W-2s) is filed once a year, online in TAP or by mail, but the page does not print its due date; none is recorded.

Form 910 filing frequencies and due dates: the page says a 910 is filed for every period (monthly, quarterly) but states no thresholds or dates, so no deposit schedule is computed. A 'zero' 910 is filed either online or by mail, not both.
Form 96, Annual Information Return, is due the last day of February.
Idaho unemployment insurance (Department of Labor): no document read.
The January 31 due date of Form 967 is assumed, not read.

channels.function: withholding returns (Form 910, 967), W-2/1099 filing, substitute forms
channels.description: Idaho TaxAccess Point (TAP); the Commission publishes Substitute Forms Specifications so software can produce approved substitute withholding forms
enrollment: Register for an Idaho withholding account (steps not read) and use TAP.
To produce substitute withholding forms from software, follow the Commission's Substitute Forms Specifications and contact its Substitute Forms Help Desk for approval.
